data.name: Tekram
data.gender_notes: Tekram is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Tekram is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a compound of two words 'Te' which means 'Time' and 'Kram' which means 'God'. The name Tekram represents the God of Time and is believed to bring strength, power, and bravery. This name is perfect for a boy who is destined for great things and is expected to leave a lasting impact on the world.
data.spiritual_meaning: Tekram is a powerful name that signifies the presence of God in one's life. It represents the power of time and the ability to harness it to achieve great things. It is a name that is deeply rooted in Hinduism and is believed to bring strength, courage, and wisdom to the one who bears it.
data.etymology: Tekram belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Time.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tekram total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Tekram holds a significant cultural impact in Hinduism as it is associated with the God of Time. This deity is revered for his control over the flow of time and is believed to grant his devotees power, strength, and the ability to overcome challenges. The name Tekram is also a reminder of the transient nature of life and the importance of making the most of every moment.
data.spiritual_significance: On a more spiritual level, the name Tekram signifies the divine power that governs the universe and our lives. It serves as a reminder that time is not in our control, and we must make the most of every moment by living our lives with purpose and intention. The name Tekram also represents the idea of time being a powerful ally and provider of opportunities for growth and transformation. By embracing the spiritual significance of this name, one can cultivate greater inner strength, resilience, and a sense of determination to overcome any challenges that come their way.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Tekram: God of Time and Destiny. Symbolizes the belief in the power of the divine will in shaping one's life. The name invokes trust in the eternal plan and the courage to face challenges with grace.

historical_references.reference: According to local folklore, Tekram was a powerful local deity worshipped in the medieval period in Bengal, India. He was believed to protect the fields and crops from destruction by evil forces.

Another reference suggests that Tekram was a major Hindu god in the ancient Shakta tradition, particularly popular in Nepal and eastern India during the 7th to 13th centuries. He was believed to be the god of fertility and agriculture, and was often depicted holding a trident and a serpent.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Tekram continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
